payload.author: experimental_development
payload.hypothesis: Multi-scale joint attention (scales 2/4/7) captures both fine nuclear morphology and coarse tissue architecture simultaneously, better resolving confusable histopathology classes (background/debris/mucus, smooth muscle/stroma) than a single-scale CNN. The 196-token scale-2 branch provides sub-cellular detail while the 16-token scale-7 branch provides global tissue context, and joint attention allows cross-scale feature interaction that a hierarchical CNN cannot replicate.
